caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "Coherency" displays performance scores for four different prompt versions (V1, V2, V3, and V4) of the HDM model in the context of humour translation, as measured by the GEMBA-SQM metric. The horizontal axis (x-axis) lists the four prompt versions—V1, V2, V3, and V4—in sequential order from left to right. The vertical axis (y-axis) represents the coherency score, ranging from 86 to 100 in increments of 2, with dashed gridlines marking each interval. Each bar corresponds to one prompt version and is color-coded: V1 is blue, V2 is orange, V3 is green, and V4 is purple. The bars are arranged in descending order of height from left to right, with V3 achieving the highest score at 94.5, followed by V1 at 93.69, V2 at 93.8, and V4 at 91.1. The values are explicitly labeled atop each bar, allowing for precise comparison. The chart visually emphasizes that V3 performs best in coherency, while V4 shows the lowest score among the four. No additional annotations, error bars, or grouping are present.
